description: This is an abstract base class for testing Reminder Table implementations in Orleans. It includes setup, teardown, and various test helper methods for interacting with reminder storage, such as inserting, reading, and deleting reminders, as well as range queries and concurrency tests.

classes.name: ReminderTableTestsBase
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common setup, teardown, and utility methods for testing various IReminderTable implementations within Orleans, including reminder CRUD and range query tests.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the reminder table, starts its operation asynchronously.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up resources, optionally clearing the reminder table after tests.

methods.name: CreateRemindersTable
methods.description: Abstract method to create specific IReminderTable instances.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the database connection string.

methods.name: GetAdoInvariant
methods.description: Provides the ADO.NET invariant string, can be overridden for specific database types.

methods.name: RemindersParallelUpsert
methods.description: Performs parallel upsert operations on reminders to test concurrency handling.

methods.name: ReminderSimple
methods.description: Performs a simple sequence of upsert, read, and delete operations on a reminder to verify correctness.

methods.name: RemindersRange
methods.description: Tests range retrieval of reminders, including hash-based filtering and verification.

methods.name: TestRemindersHashInterval
methods.description: Helper function to verify that reminders returned within a hash interval match expectations.

methods.name: CreateReminder
methods.description: Creates a new ReminderEntry with typical test values.

methods.name: MakeTestGrainReference
methods.description: Generates a test GrainId reference for reminder testing.
